startingCard.title: George H. W. Bush becomes president of the United States
startingCard.fact: George Herbert Walker Bush was the 41st president of the United States, serving from 1989 to 1993.

cards.title: ‘The Bourne Supremacy’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Paul Greengrass
cards.fact: The Bourne Supremacy is a 2004 American action-thriller film starring Matt Damon as Robert Ludlum's character Jason Bourne, a former CIA assassin suffering from psychogenic amnesia trying to learn more of his past when he is enveloped in a conspiracy involving the CIA and Treadstone.

cards.title: Sant'Andrea al Quirinale is completed
cards.subtitle: Church in Rome
cards.fact: The Church of Saint Andrew on the Quirinal is a Roman Catholic titular church in Rome, Italy, built for the Jesuit seminary on the Quirinal Hill.

cards.title: Boxer Rebellion
cards.subtitle: Protest, riot, or uprising
cards.fact: The Boxer Rebellion, also known as the Boxer Uprising, Boxer Movement, or Yihetuan Movement, was an anti-foreign, anti-imperialist, and anti-Christian uprising in North China between 1899 and 1901, towards the end of the Qing dynasty, by the Society of Righteous and Harmonious Fists.

cards.title: ‘The Count of Monte Cristo’ is published
cards.subtitle: Book by Alexandre Dumas
cards.fact: The Count of Monte Cristo is an adventure novel by the French writer Alexandre Dumas.

cards.title: Abbasid Caliphate is established
cards.subtitle: Historical state
cards.fact: The Abbasid Caliphate or Abbasid Empire was the third Islamic caliphate, ruled by the Abbasid dynasty.

cards.title: James Monroe becomes president of the United States
cards.fact: James Monroe was an American Founding Father who served as the fifth president of the United States from 1817 to 1825.

cards.title: ‘Malcolm in the Middle’ airs for the first time
cards.subtitle: American television sitcom
cards.fact: Malcolm in the Middle is an American television sitcom created by Linwood Boomer for the Fox Broadcasting Company.

cards.title: ‘To Have and Have Not’ is published
cards.subtitle: Book by Ernest Hemingway
cards.fact: To Have and Have Not is a novel by Ernest Hemingway published in 1937 by Charles Scribner's Sons.

cards.title: ‘The Martian’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Ridley Scott
cards.fact: The Martian is a 2015 epic science fiction survival film directed by Ridley Scott from a screenplay by Drew Goddard.

cards.title: ‘Street Fighter V’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Dimps
cards.fact: Street Fighter V is a 2016 fighting game developed by Capcom and Dimps and published by Capcom for PlayStation 4 and Windows.

cards.title: ‘Uncharted 3: Drake's Deception’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Naughty Dog
cards.fact: Uncharted 3: Drake's Deception is a 2011 action-adventure game developed by Naughty Dog and published by Sony Computer Entertainment for the PlayStation 3.

cards.title: Tony Blair becomes prime minister of the United Kingdom
cards.fact: Sir Anthony Charles Lynton Blair is a British politician who served as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom from 1997 to 2007 and Leader of the Labour Party from 1994 to 2007.

cards.title: ‘Herakles' Children’ premieres
cards.subtitle: Play by Euripides
cards.fact: Children of Heracles is an Athenian tragedy written by Euripides.

cards.title: ‘El Chavo del 8’ airs for the first time
cards.subtitle: Mexican television sitcom
cards.fact: El Chavo, also known as El Chavo del Ocho is a Mexican television sitcom created by Chespirito and produced by Televisa.

cards.title: ‘Postal III’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Running with Scissors
cards.fact: Postal III is a third-person shooter video game developed by Trashmasters and Running with Scissors, and published by Akella.

cards.title: Albrecht Dürer dies
cards.subtitle: German painter, printmaker, mathematician, and theorist
cards.fact: Albrecht Dürer, sometimes spelled in English as Durer or Duerer, was a German painter, printmaker, and theorist of the German Renaissance.

cards.title: ‘28 Days Later’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Danny Boyle
cards.fact: 28 Days Later is a 2002 British post-apocalyptic horror film directed by Danny Boyle and written by Alex Garland.

cards.title: ‘Ecliptica’ is released
cards.subtitle: Album by Sonata Arctica
cards.fact: Ecliptica is the first full-length album by the power metal band Sonata Arctica.

cards.title: ‘Excitebike’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Nintendo Research & Development 1
cards.fact: Excitebike is a 1984 racing video game developed and published by Nintendo for the Nintendo Entertainment System.

cards.title: Muhammad Ali dies
cards.subtitle: American boxer
cards.fact: Muhammad Ali was an American professional boxer and activist.

cards.title: Artemis III launches
cards.subtitle: Mission by National Aeronautics and Space Administration
cards.fact: Artemis III is planned to be the second crewed mission of the NASA-led Artemis lunar exploration program.

cards.title: Marek Grechuta dies
cards.subtitle: Polish singer and composer
cards.fact: Marek Michał Grechuta was a Polish singer, songwriter, composer, and lyricist.

cards.title: Salvador Dalí dies
cards.subtitle: Spanish artist
cards.fact: Salvador Domingo Felipe Jacinto Dalí i Domènech, Marquess of Dalí de Púbol, known as Salvador Dalí, was a Spanish surrealist artist renowned for his technical skill, precise draftsmanship, and the striking and bizarre images in his work.

cards.title: ‘Hang-On’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Sega AM2
cards.fact: Hang-On is a 1985 racing video game developed and published by Sega for arcades.

cards.title: Leon Trotsky dies
cards.subtitle: Russian Marxist revolutionary
cards.fact: Lev Davidovich Trotsky, better known as Leon Trotsky, was a Russian revolutionary, Soviet politician and political theorist.

cards.title: ‘The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Nintendo Entertainment Analysis & Development
cards.fact: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker is an action-adventure game developed and published by Nintendo for the GameCube.

cards.title: Swami Vivekananda dies
cards.subtitle: Indian Hindu monk and philosopher
cards.fact: Swami Vivekananda, born Narendranath Datta, was an Indian Hindu monk, philosopher, author, religious teacher, and the chief disciple of the Indian mystic Ramakrishna.

cards.title: ‘Keeps Gettin' Better: A Decade of Hits’ is released
cards.subtitle: Album by Christina Aguilera
cards.fact: Keeps Gettin' Better: A Decade of Hits is the first greatest hits album by American singer-songwriter Christina Aguilera.

cards.title: ‘Phantasmagoria’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Sierra Entertainment
cards.fact: Phantasmagoria is a point-and-click adventure horror video game designed by Roberta Williams for MS-DOS and Microsoft Windows and released by Sierra On-Line on August 24, 1995.

cards.title: Colosseum is completed
cards.subtitle: Ancient Roman amphitheatre, a landmark of Rome, Italy
cards.fact: The Colosseum is an elliptical amphitheatre in the centre of the city of Rome, Italy, just east of the Roman Forum.
